description_en: Update the tag value of an organization member
kebab_example: aliyun quickbi-public update-user-tag-value --user-id fe67f61a35a94b7da1a34ba174a70000 --tag-id pop_001 --tag-value '产品总监' --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateUserTagValue

parameters.help_en: The user ID for which the tag value is to be modified. This user ID refers to the Quick BI UserID, not the Alibaba Cloud UID
parameters.help_zh: 待修改标签值的用户ID。此处的用户ID为Quick BI的UserID，而非阿里云的UID
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the tag to be modified
parameters.name: tag_id

parameters.help_en:
The tag value to be modified.

To clear this tag, set the tag value to ($NULL$).
For multiple values, use English commas to separate them.
Format validation, maximum length: 3000 characters
parameters.help_zh:
待修改的标签值。

如果需要清除该标签，则设置标签值为（$NULL$）。
多值请用英文逗号分割。
格式校验，最大长度：3000字符
parameters.name: tag_value

Result.description_en:
Returns the result of modifying the user tag. Possible values:

true: Operation succeeded
false: Operation failed
Result.description_zh:
返回修改用户标签的结果。取值范围：

true：执行成功
false：执行失败

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Value range:
true: The request was successful - false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
是否请求成功。取值范围：

true：请求成功
false：请求失败
